In our league he went for 15 USD last season, and the experts rank him around 55 to 75 now that he starts at point guard. A bid of about 13 to 18 USD looks like good value. He fits builds that want 3PM, FT%, PTS and AST from a guard, but he gives little in steals and blocks, has some turnovers and is slightly below average in FG%, so he pairs well with stocks-heavy bigs.
